Kit summary

AgitationBasic
Deals 160% ATK DMG and 160% ATK [Poison] DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison · Fright] for 2 turns. Afterward, refreshes the duration of all [Poison] on the target.
Fright ImpactActive
Deals 3 stages of 80% ATK [Poison] DMG each to all enemies, each having a 70% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison · Fright] for 2 turns. When all allies have acted for 1 turn at least, Giselle will additionally cast Fright Impact once, which will also reduce all enemies' Turn Meters by 10% this time. Afterward, the action turns will be counted from 0.
Bewitching PoisonPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Giselle is immune to Turn Meter Reduction effect. Each time Giselle inflicts [Poison · Fright], she also inflicts 1 layer of [Bewitchment] for 2 turns. [Poison · Fright]: Each turn before action, the target takes DMG by 50% of Giselle's ATK, considered as [Poison] but does not count towards the max limit on layers of [Poison], stackable up to 10 layers, affected by Skill DMG bonuses, and ignores [DMG Immunity]. Reduces DMG dealt by the target with [Poison · Fright] by 30% (cannot be stacked with [Poison]). [Bewitchment]: Each layer reduces the owner's Mastery by 8.4% and Crit DMG by 8.4%.
Fright Staff Lv.1When a battle starts, for every 1% Mastery owned by Giselle, additionally grants self 0.5% Effect Hit, up to 120% can be gained this way. Each time Giselle inflicts 1 layer of a debuff on the enemy or an enemy cleanses 1 layer of a debuff, Giselle also removes 1 layer of a buff from the enemy. For every 1 enemy with [Bewitchment] exists, Giselle increases Skill DMG Reduction by 10%.
Fright Staff Lv.2When [Poison · Fright] deals DMG, Giselle restores HP by 100% of the DMG dealt. For every 10 layers of [Poison] inflicted by allies, reduces the CD of all Giselle's skills by 1 turn. When Giselle is pursued and attacked by the skill against a single target, there is a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison · Fright] on the attacker for 2 turns. Meanwhile, triggers [Poison] for once. Each time she is pursued and attacked, triggers 1 more layer of [Poison] (up to 6 layers can be triggered). The triggered layers will be reset when Giselle's turn begins.
Fright Staff Lv.3At the beginning of an enemy's turn, removes their [Block Debuff]. Afterward, there is a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison · Fright] on them for 2 turns, [ATK Down Ⅱ] for 1 turn, and [Cold II] for 1 turn. If the target already has [Poison · Fright], Giselle has a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison · Fright] on all other enemies for 2 turns. After all allies have taken DMG, Giselle cleanses all control effects from self and acts immediately for 1 turn. This effect can only be triggered once each wave.
Haunting HandActive
Grants all allies [ATK Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 11 stages of DMG to enemies. Each of the first 10 stages deals 80% ATK [Poison] DMG to a random single enemy, prioritizing attacking different targets and the last stage deals 80% ATK [Poison] DMG to all enemies; each stage has a 90% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison · Fright] for 2 turns. While Haunting Hand is cast, targets with 3 or more layers of [Poisonon · Fright] also have a 45% chance to be inflicted with [Stun] for 1 turn. When Haunting Hand deals DMG to the Boss, for every 1 layer of [Poison] owned by the Boss, increases DMG dealt by 20%, up to 400%.
Source: game files.
